cleanrooms.caveats: Clean Rooms queries translate to BigQuery on-demand analysis; reservation models differ
cleanrooms.guidance: Map AWS Clean Rooms analysis queries to BigQuery on-demand analysis ($6.25/TB) or passthrough if query volume is unavailable.

bedrock.caveats: Foundation model pricing is token-based; compare equivalent model sizes (e.g. Claude vs Gemini)
bedrock.guidance: Map Amazon Bedrock token consumption to Google Cloud Vertex AI Gemini API pricing.

appsync.caveats: Managed GraphQL on AWS; GCP uses API Gateway or Cloud Run with GraphQL server
appsync.guidance: Map AWS AppSync query and real-time subscription operations to GCP API Gateway request rates ($3.00/million calls).

mq.caveats: No direct 1:1 serverless managed ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ on GCP; self-host or use Cloud Tasks
mq.guidance: Amazon MQ broker-hours map to equivalent Compute Engine e2-standard VM hours or Cloud Tasks.

keyspaces.caveats: Managed Apache Cassandra on AWS; Cloud Bigtable is the standard GCP wide-column NoSQL analogue
keyspaces.guidance: Map Amazon Keyspaces read/write throughput units and storage to Cloud Bigtable node and storage pricing.

eventbridge.caveats: Eventarc routes events across GCP services with native Pub/Sub backing
eventbridge.guidance: Map Amazon EventBridge event bus ingest to Google Cloud Eventarc routing fees ($0.60/million events).

rekognition.caveats: Vision API prices per feature detection operation
rekognition.guidance: Map Amazon Rekognition image and video analysis to Google Cloud Vision API feature units ($1.50/1,000 units).

translate.caveats: Character volume pricing with standard translation tier
translate.guidance: Map Amazon Translate characters to Google Cloud Translation API ($20/million characters).

polly.caveats: Standard vs Neural voices have different per-million character tiers
polly.guidance: Map Amazon Polly character synthesis to Google Cloud Text-to-Speech API ($4.00/million characters for standard, $16.00/million for Journey/Neural).

textract.guidance: Map Amazon Textract page extraction to Google Cloud Document AI OCR / Form parser per-page pricing ($1.50-$30/1,000 pages).

comprehend.guidance: Map Amazon Comprehend analysis units to Google Cloud Natural Language API request pricing.

connect.caveats: Telephony and agent seat models vary widely across clouds
connect.guidance: Map Amazon Connect cloud contact center minutes to Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI) or passthrough at cost parity.
